key_reasoning.reason: The workflow router's YAML rewrite helper changed from regenerating yaml_config out of the typed WorkflowConfig objects to parsing the YAML as sent and patching only the normalized model ids (_patch_model_ids_in_yaml). This alters what is persisted on both POST and PUT, so the stored-YAML contract changes. There is no security, auth or schema impact and the change is easy to roll back.
Only the router-local YAML helpers in routers/workflow.py changed: _rewrite_yaml_config_from_objects, plus a new _patch_model_ids_in_yaml. No other component is touched.
